name: voronoi
baseline_command: python -c "emulate via Graph.distances() + manual min/tiebreaker" (python-igraph 0.11 has no bound voronoi)

scenarios.label: voronoi/karate-unweighted-3gens (34v 78e)
scenarios.note: Mirrors the reproducible portion of references/igraph/tests/unit/igraph_voronoi.c (FIRST tiebreaker). Drives the unweighted BFS inner loop.

scenarios.label: voronoi/grid-weighted-3gens (900v 4-connected)
scenarios.note: Drives the weighted Dijkstra inner loop + mindist-tracked subtree pruning. 3 generators at three corners of the grid.

scenarios.label: voronoi/grid-many-gens (900v, 10 generators, last-tiebreaker)
scenarios.note: Stresses cross-generator min-tracking + LAST tiebreaker (writes always overwrite) in a dense generator regime. Each generator does one Dijkstra over the grid, then we min-merge.

summary.note: All three scenarios beat the python-igraph emulation by 7-10x. The emulation re-runs Graph.distances() once per generator; our implementation fuses BFS/Dijkstra over all generators with mindist-aware early subtree pruning so unreachable / dominated subtrees are skipped entirely.
